title: User Cleaner
menu.title: User Cleaner
intro.heading: Read this before you touch anything
intro.body: This tool permanently deletes user accounts. Deletions cannot be undone. Always run a preview first, check the sample list, and keep the dry-run switch on until you are satisfied the filters match what you expect. Administrators, global moderators, category moderators and your own account are always excluded, whatever the filters say.
filters.heading: Filters
filters.max-postcount-help: Matches users with at most this many posts. 0 = users who never posted.
filters.max-reputation-help: Matches users with at most this much reputation.
filters.last-online-help: Accounts that have never logged in are compared against their registration date.
filters.account-age-help: Protects recent registrations from a broad rule. Leave at 1 month or more.
filters.email-unconfirmed: Only accounts that never confirmed their email address
filters.never-logged-in: Only accounts that registered and never came back
filters.profile-spam: Only accounts with a filled-in profile (name, signature, about me or avatar)
filters.email-pattern-help: Case-insensitive regular expression. Also matches addresses that were never confirmed, which are not shown on the user profile. Leave empty to disable.
filters.include-groups-help: Leave empty to consider all users.
filters.exclude-groups: Never delete members of these groups
filters.exclude-groups-help: For example donators or verified members.
deletion.heading: Deletion behaviour
deletion.content-mode: What to do with the user's content
deletion.content-purge: Purge the account and all of its posts, topics and uploads
deletion.content-keep: Delete the account but keep its content
deletion.content-mode-help: Irrelevant when the post-count filter is 0, since matched users have no content.
deletion.concurrency-help: How many accounts are deleted at the same time (1-20). The ACP user list does the same thing when you delete a selection. Raise it for faster runs, lower it if the forum feels sluggish during a run.
deletion.limit-help: A safety valve. The preview still reports the full match count.
action.dry-run-help: On: Run starts a background job that scans and lists the matching accounts and deletes nothing — the same result as Preview, but with live progress and a downloadable list. Turn it off to actually delete.
action.dry-run-off-help: Off: Run will permanently delete the matched accounts after you confirm. This switch resets itself to on after every real run.
results.heading: Results
results.empty: Run a preview to see how many accounts match.
progress.heading: Job
sample.heading: Sample of matched accounts
alert.dry-run-started: Dry run started. Nothing will be deleted.
alert.run-started: Deletion job started. The progress bar at the top of this page keeps updating, and survives a page reload.
confirm.title: Permanently delete accounts
confirm.body: You are about to permanently delete %1 user accounts. This cannot be undone.
confirm.purge-warning: All posts, topics and uploads belonging to these accounts will be purged as well.
confirm.keep-warning: The accounts will be removed but their posts and topics will remain, attributed to a guest.
confirm.type-count: Type the number of matched accounts (%1) to continue:
error.preview-first: Run a preview before starting a real deletion run.
error.filters-too-broad: These filters would match active accounts. Set at least a last-online period, an account age, or another narrowing condition.
error.job-running: A user cleaner job is already running.
error.confirm-count: Confirmation count did not match the previewed number of accounts.
error.invalid-email-pattern: The email pattern is not a valid regular expression.
error.count-drifted: The number of matching accounts changed between the preview and the run, so nothing was deleted. Preview again and re-confirm.
